Results.ReviewText: We bought an almost never used S 210 from a neighbor. It's stainless steel and two burners. A little brother to the S-310. I think it was last made in 2013 but looks new. We currently have another brand that was an off-shore creation and difficult to work with. Our new Weber is a joy. Turn on the control knob, hit the igniter and you're in business. Our first Weber was a kettle in 1968! Yellow too! Long gone but still fondly remembered. Our Weber is a fine piece of engineering and craftsmanship. Thank you Weber.

Results.ReviewText:
Really nice grill. It seems like it is sturdy, made from solid, thicker, metal pieces and may last a while. The price seemed high for me, but looking at other quality grills it was actually right in line for the size. 

I gave it a four star as it takes a long time to assemble and it is an intricate build. I would have been much more satisfied if I had the store build it. If you get this grill have them build it. 

Also it can make a funny intermittent noise while cooking. Apparently that is a normal noise and not a concern. However I’ve never had another grill that has sounds. 

So overall I’m happy. I’ll get used to the new noise and forget the build. I’ll have a quality grill that lasts and cooks really well.
Results.Title: Quality grill, some small issues

Results.ReviewText: The left shelf is a folding assembly which is also used as the "grips" which move the grill around the yard.  This is not a "purpose built" handle and it is possible that the shelf may bend into an unrepairable shape during moving.  I was previously advised by Weber to read the grill warranty. The Spirit grill warranty does not cover normal "wear and tear".  Will I recieve a new shelf if it is damaged by moving?  I don't know.  If someone from Weber reads this, please respond.
Results.Title: Could be Damaged During Regular Use!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
